program_type: University full scholarship (university fund + national NL Scholarship)
duration: If the scholarship covers only tuition fees, make sure you can finance your living expenses (rent, food and insurances) for the complete duration of your studies.

title: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
program_type: University scholarship for excellent non-EU/EEA students applying to an English-taught master's programme
duration: 1 year, renewable into a second year for students on a two-year MSc programme if the published progress requirements are met.
description: The University of Twente Scholarship is a scholarship for excellent students from non-EU/EEA countries applying for an English-taught master's programme at the University of Twente. Its value ranges from EUR 3,000 to EUR 22,000 for one year and is intended as compensation for study-related costs, with no costs such as tuition fees paid on the student's behalf; for two-year programmes a second-year award of an equal amount is possible if the student obtains an average grade of 7 out of 10 and at least 50 percent of the European Credits at the end of the third quartile of the first year. program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver for non-EU/EEA students
duration: One- or two-year full-time English-taught Master's programme starting September 2027
description: The VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP) is a merit-based tuition fee waiver from Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam for non-EU/EEA applicants who pay higher tuition fees. title: Lund University Global Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee scholarship for non-EU/EEA students
duration: One academic year of tuition fees for the degree programme applied for; grants cover part or all of the tuition fees depending on the programme/faculty budget

title: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee scholarship for international fee-paying students
duration: One academic year, covering the full tuition fee of the international Master's programme applied for
description: The Uppsala University Global Scholarship is awarded to a limited number of international fee-paying Master's students each year and covers the full tuition fee of the programme, but not living expenses. It is funded by the Swedish Council for Higher Education and is open to citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland. Selection is merit-based and financial need is not considered; Uppsala states that only about 2% of applicants are granted a scholarship. title: KTH Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee scholarship for fee-paying international students
duration: One or two-year master's programme; the scholarship covers the tuition fee for the first and the second year provided the first-year study results are satisfactory
description: The KTH Scholarship covers the full tuition fee of a one- or two-year master's programme at KTH Royal Institute of Technology for fee-paying students, and does not include living costs. Applicants must first apply for a KTH master's programme through universityadmissions.se, ranking KTH as their first priority and paying the application fee. The 2027 round opens on 1 December 2026 and closes on 15 January 2027, with results announced on 1 April 2027. In 2026, 9% of scholarship applicants who were admitted to a programme were nominated for the scholarship (65 out of 718).
